hook: Your hike ends at a waterfall frozen in stone.
title: A Waterfall Frozen In Solid Stone
description:
Hierve el Agua in Oaxaca, Mexico looks like a waterfall turned to rock. Mineral-rich spring water flows over the cliff and leaves minerals behind, slowly building the formations. It is not ice and it is not a statue.

#Shorts #HierveElAgua #Mexico
comment_prompt: Would you hike here? Yes or no
